ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with a ratio of approximately 60% low-intensity (dark) to 40% high-intensity (white) pixels. The left lobe is predominantly low-intensity, while the right lobe features a large high-intensity field.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe contains a broad high-intensity white field (roughly 70% of its area) with scattered low-intensity speckling and a thick dark trailing edge band. Left lobe is predominantly low-intensity dark pixels with sparse high-intensity clusters concentrated near the median notch and leading edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth relative to the lobe peaks of approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular peaks and valleys (1-4 pixel variance) along the continuous linear boundary, with significant jaggedness and texture at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to a slight concavity near the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular pixel clusters (grey/white) detected at the terminal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with epibiont colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical high-contrast linear disruptions visible against the dark pigmentation of the left lobe's mid-section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of clustered barnacle colonies/scarring at the distal edges of both lobes; extreme asymmetry in pigmentation between the left and right fluke surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark pigmentation band extending from the trailing edge into the high-intensity field of the right lobe.
